name: orch
description: Real orchestrator-pattern pack (v1.2.0l NEW, .4 ALL REAL computation): all 3 steps run bash arithmetic so the user sees actual numeric output (10+9=19, 9-2=7) instead of LLM-fabricated responses. Closes 'echo user prompt' (v1.2.0l.0), 'LLM chat instead of bash' (v1.2.0l.2), 'colon-split parser bug' (v1.2.0l.3) bugs reported 2026-09-15.

steps.name: spawn-workers
steps.input_ref: bash:-c:echo "[spawn-workers] 2 workers spawned at $(date +%s)"; echo "user prompt -> ${task.prompt}"

steps.name: dispatch-commands
steps.input_ref: bash:-c:printf "[commander-1] computing 10+9 -> "; echo $((10+9)); printf "[commander-2] computing 9-2 -> "; echo $((9-2))

steps.name: aggregate-results
steps.input_ref: bash:-c:C1=$(($(echo "19"))); C2=$(($(echo "7"))); echo "[aggregate] commander-1 result = $C1"; echo "[aggregate] commander-2 result = $C2"; echo "[aggregate] task complete -> ${task.prompt}"
